name: Manichaean Pantheon (Lightworld Hierarchy)
dom: Cosmological hierarchy of the Realm of Light: the Father of Greatness and the successive Evocations deployed in the cosmic drama of the mixing and rescue of Light.
note: Connectivity hub for the Manichaean cohort; a structural collective node grouping the Lightworld emanations described in the Kephalaia and Psalm-Book, not an attested cult-figure. Prefix ENT_MANICH_ matches the existing tradition roster (distinct from Mandaean ENT_MAN_).
